title: The 50-30-20 rule: where your salary should go
description:
A simple rule to split any salary so you save without feeling broke.

#money #budget #personalfinance

scenes.narration: Salary comes in, and by the twentieth it is gone. Here is the fix.
Split every rupee three ways. Fifty percent for needs like rent, food and EMIs.
Thirty percent for wants, the movies, the trips, the new phone.
And twenty percent goes to savings first, before you spend anything.
Automate that twenty percent on salary day, and your future self will thank you. Follow for more money tips.

facts_to_check: The 50-30-20 rule splits take-home pay into needs, wants and savings
